previousFullCatalogueValidation.scopeNote: This is the separate successful post-merge catalogue workflow. The earlier full local image-validation attempt stalled and was terminated; it remains incomplete.

classificationDefinitions.A: Exact file, source, creator and file-level license/reuse terms established.
classificationDefinitions.B: Exact file/source established, but creator/required attribution remains unresolved.
classificationDefinitions.C: Exact file/source established, but authority to grant the stated license or reuse permission is not established.
classificationDefinitions.D: Likely source candidate, but exact file identity is not proven.

readiness.rule: Only A records may proceed to a separate metadata implementation PR. No partial metadata is proposed for B or C.

metadataSchemaCheck.fieldTypes: All four are required strings when the optional imageMetadata object is present.

existingWikimediaExamples.attribution: Reggaeman, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

metadataSchemaCheck.generatedOutputContract: scripts/catalog/generate-outputs.ts serializes each full canonical Destination to public/data/destinations/<id>.json; scripts/catalog/client-index.ts includes imageMetadata in the lite index. scripts/sync-destination-details.ts writes these projections; a later implementation must regenerate and run check:catalog-sync. Current canonical/detail metadata parity is true for all six (both absent).

sharedAuthoringPath.rootCause: HubSeed has no imageMetadata member. The writer chooses/reuses heroImage, spreads the seed, and pushes the record without imageMetadata. The current-ID guard skips existing rows, so rerunning this script does not backfill the six records.
sharedAuthoringPath.otherSeedMetadataPresence: 15 of the 16 other seeds have an imageMetadata object; presence is not a provenance-quality finding and their sources were not re-audited here.

additionalUnpublishedGap.whyNotInSixWarningRows: The current MISSING_IMAGE_METADATA rule applies only when status === published; this record is verified. Its image/file creator/license were not researched or classified in this six-record audit.
additionalUnpublishedGap.disposition: Out of scope; no data or generator change. Track separately before broadening the cohort.

sharedAuthoringPath.preventionRecommendation: Open a separate, code-only prevention PR. Require file-level imageMetadata evidence for every new image-bearing HubSeed (or copy it only from a source record whose heroImage is exactly reused and whose metadata is present); fail before any catalogue write if provenance is absent. Resolve Wikipedia PageImages selections to the exact file page rather than treating the delivery URL as provenance. Add a no-write regression test for missing metadata. Do not use a generic contributor/license fallback.

file.currentUrlIdentity: The current 3840px thumbnail path, including hash 3/35 and filename, matches the Commons API thumburl path; host differs (upload.wikimedia.org vs thumb.wikimedia.org). The API thumb rendition is 3840 × 2555.
file.sourceClaim: Commons Source={{own}}; the page description says 'Taken by Shogo Nishiyama' and links only to the Flickr account album list.
file.relatedFlickrAlbumObservation: The Flickr page is titled Kinosaki Onsen and shows the photographer account nishiyamashogo with 1,812 photos; it does not identify an exact photo permalink matching this Commons file.
file.directCurrentUrlProbe: The catalogue upload-host request returned HTTP 429; the Commons API provided the matching thumb.wikimedia.org rendition path.

specificMissingEvidence: The Commons page simultaneously claims own work by Samchan91 and says the photograph was taken by Shogo Nishiyama. It does not explain whether these names refer to the same person or whether Samchan91 had authority from the photographer.
The page links to an album-list URL, not the exact Flickr photo page. The inspected Kinosaki Onsen album contains 1,812 photos and supplies no exact source-photo permalink for this image.

No photographer authorization or exact original-photo license record was found. Therefore the Commons CC BY-SA 4.0 label is present, but the authority to grant reuse permission for this exact image remains unverified.
